content: Vector3.project(camera) transforms a world-space point into normalized device coordinates (NDC), range -1..1 on x/y, z indicates depth (z>1 means behind camera, hide the label). Convert NDC to pixel coords: x_px = (ndc.x*0.5+0.5)*canvas.clientWidth; y_px = (-ndc.y*0.5+0.5)*canvas.clientHeight. Recompute every animation frame the object might move or the camera moves, since screen position depends on both. Three.js also ships CSS2DRenderer/CSS3DRenderer as a built-in alternative that manages DOM label positioning automatically, but manual project() is the direct/explicit approach consistent with vanilla learning goals.
